svg.title: Buo mascot sheet
svg.desc: Eight states of the original green robot mascot: idle, listening, thinking, talking, happy, celebrate, confused, sleepy; plus size legibility test.
svg.text: Original parametric robot rig. Parts: head, visor, eyes, mouth, antenna, ear pods, body, arms, accent. All colours are CSS variables bound to design tokens.
Legibility: 160 px, 64 px, 32 px (dark surface and light surface)
